keyPoints: Ankganit ki mool prameya: har bhajya sankhya abhajya gunankhandon ke guna ke roop me ek hi tarah likhi ja sakti hai.
HCF = common abhajya gunankhandon ki chhoti ghaton ka guna; LCM = sabhi ki badi ghaton ka guna.
HCF x LCM = dono sankhyaon ka guna — 12 aur 18 ke liye 6 x 36 = 216 = 12 x 18.
√2, √3, √5 aparimey hain — virodh se siddh: agar p/q hota to ansh-har dono sam hote, jo manak roop ke viruddh hai.
Parimey sankhya p/q ka dashamlav samapt hoga agar q = 2^n x 5^m ke roop ka ho — jaise 7/80 = 0.0875 — har ke gunankhand sirf 2 aur 5 hain.
Agar q me 2, 5 ke siva koi abhajya gunankhand ho to dashamlav asant dohraav wala hoga.
Aam galti: HCF x LCM ka sutra teen sankhyaon par lagana — ye sirf do sankhyaon ke liye hai.

title: Vastavik Sankhyaen: Abhajya Gunankhand
